CompanyName.description: Defines the publishing company of the ItemVersion. The companyName is part of the main identifier of an ItemVersion together with the corresponding number (partNumber or documentNumber) and version (partVersion or documentVersion).

ResourceNumber.description: TheResourceNumberis the major identifier of aResourceVersion. The format is user defined and respectively company specific. For all VEC-documents aResourceVersion-instancecan be trusted to be identical if the combination ofResourceNumber,ResourceVersionandCompanyNameis identical.

ResourceVersion.description: TheResourceVersionspecifies the version index of a resource (see alsoResourceNumber).
